title: 학생군사교육실시령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 10 (Compensation Procedure)
(1) Any individual seeking compensation in accordance with Article 11-2 of the Act must submit a certificate in Form 5 to the head of the local Veterans Affairs Office or the Veterans Affairs Office responsible for their address.
(2) The certificates referred to in paragraph (1) are issued by the Minister of National Defense for individuals who received pre-enlistment education, and by the Minister of Education for individuals who received in-school education. (Amended July 27, 1989, June 22, 2007, March 4, 2008, March 23, 2013)
(3) The person authorized to issue the certificate under paragraph (2) must immediately notify the Chairman of the National Veterans Affairs Office upon issuing the certificate.
